data.narrative:
Nano Nuclear Energy is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Jay Jiang Yu, currently valued at $808M on $600M+ in total raised capital. The relevant comp universe consists of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Fuse Energy, Applied Atomics, and Exodys Energy within the nuclear energy sector.

Given the nascent and specialized nature of the nuclear energy subsector, traditional peer-median valuation was not applicable. The peer set of 11 total companies in nuclear energy did not yield sufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables to support a robust peer-multiple methodology. Therefore, valuation relied on stage-progression analysis, which applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x to the last post-money valuation of $808M, yielding an implied valuation of $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis, anchored on this single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $2.0B. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specialized capital-intensive sector and the limited observable comparable data in early-stage nuclear technology. The wide dispersion between low and high reflects this methodological constraint. Additional revenue or project milestone data would strengthen conviction in this range.
